qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews on the shared initial tree and serialized fix rechecks found the original correctness, comprehensibility, scoped-coverage and quiz-safety defects resolved. 負け drops an unsourced claim that 敗北 sounds more bookish and glosses 今回は私の負けです non-past («это мой проигрыш»); 越す, 販売 and 貢献 no longer depend on English-language glosses (the «распродажа» warning is restated in Russian); 働き contrasts 労働 «труд» (労働時間 «рабочее время») with the person's or organ's work shown in its examples. The reviews ran on a local unsigned commit whose tree is identical to the signed candidate 3109d3d; the records state this. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.
qualifiedVerdicts.fallbackAndVoice: Tag/random fallback options, voice/reading prompts and drawing not cleared.
qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 37 EN exclusions are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 19 direct, one-sided exclusions: 身体–生物; 越す–引っ越す/移る/過ぎる; 与える–くれる/くださる; 贈る–あげる/差し上げる/上げる; 恩–御礼; 貸し–貸す; 貴重–高価; 係–責任; 働き–労働/運転/動く; 責任–担当; 販売–売る; 負け–負ける. 越す–過ぎる and 貴重–高価 were added after review. 係 was retitled «ответственный (за порученное дело); ведение» before review because «поручение» exactly matched the 依頼 and 用事 titles. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 22 relative links across the 12 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions. No surrounding prose was changed. In kanji/負.md the RU sentence lacks EN's separate "see 責任" clause, so the 責任 link sits on 責任 in 責任を負う. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 30 selected 30 word cards from the frozen source: chunk 0 of the 89-batch dependency-closed queue of the general remaining-word pool (30 of 2,667 remaining EN words, recomputed after Batch 190).
